blocks.title: What organisational change means
blocks.coverage: Change management; tool-based, process-based and critical approaches; evidence versus the repeated 70% failure claim.
blocks.visual_method: Схема трёх подходов; отделить факт от утверждения менеджера.

blocks.title: Drivers and evidence
blocks.coverage: Internal and external drivers; PESTE/PESTL pressures; internal examples; interacting causes; unclear boundaries and competing interpretations.
blocks.visual_method: Карта источников изменений вокруг и внутри компании.

blocks.title: Planned and emergent change
blocks.coverage: Planned intentions and implementation versus change emerging through practice; how management can support emergence.
blocks.visual_method: Две временные линии возникновения изменения.

blocks.title: Scale, scope and rate
blocks.coverage: Content, scope and rate; radical, revolutionary and evolutionary change; cumulative effects; context-dependent benefits and risks.
blocks.visual_method: Шкалы масштаба и времени с разными ситуациями.

blocks.title: Critical case analysis
blocks.coverage: Distinguish stated triggers from supported explanations; management fashions; use all three Topic 1 cases and discuss alternative explanations.
blocks.visual_method: Причина → предлагаемое изменение → последствия; разные объяснения одного кейса.

blocks.title: Who can lead change
blocks.coverage: Internal/external agents; senior and middle managers; informal influencers or souls of fire; benefits and limitations of each.
blocks.visual_method: Карта участников по ролям и уровню влияния.

blocks.title: Networks and competencies
blocks.coverage: Formal authority versus informal networks; centrality, relationships and fence-sitters; distributed effort and change-manager competencies.
blocks.visual_method: Формальная структура рядом с сетью влияния.

blocks.title: People as co-producers
blocks.coverage: Affected members are active interpreters and co-producers; differing experiences, interests and meanings; limits of a manager-only story.
blocks.visual_method: Три версии одной ситуации: managers, supervisors, employees.

blocks.title: Readiness beliefs
blocks.coverage: Individual cognitive/emotional readiness and collective readiness; discrepancy, appropriateness, efficacy, principal support and valence.
blocks.visual_method: Пять вопросов о готовности, привязанных к фактам кейса.

blocks.title: Building readiness
blocks.coverage: External pressures, internal enablers and personal characteristics; participation, communication and change history; apply readiness assessment and official case.
blocks.visual_method: Карта препятствий и подходящих действий.

blocks.title: Recognising symptoms
blocks.coverage: Active versus passive/hidden resistance; observed behaviour versus inferred motive; resistance framed from multiple perspectives.
blocks.visual_method: Наблюдаемое действие отдельно от его возможных причин.

blocks.title: Explaining types
blocks.coverage: Psychological, political, cultural and sensemaking-related resistance; identity, uncertainty, interests and local meaning.
blocks.visual_method: Один конфликт — несколько обоснованных объяснений.

blocks.title: Complexity over time
blocks.coverage: Content versus process; multiple causes, ambivalence and changing intensity; compliance need not mean acceptance.
blocks.visual_method: Линия реакции до, во время и после изменения.

blocks.title: Constructive resistance and power
blocks.coverage: Resistance as useful input; dialogue, purpose, alternatives, participation and past experiences; resistance at every management level; benefits to affected people.
blocks.visual_method: Замечание сотрудника → информация → изменение решения.

blocks.title: Choosing responses
blocks.coverage: Kotter and Schlesinger: pace, six strategies, context, combinations and risks; evaluate management labelling and actions in AlphaTec.
blocks.visual_method: Причина сопротивления → подход → возможный риск.

blocks.title: The integrated TPC model
blocks.coverage: Technical, political and cultural systems across mission/strategy, structure and HR; nine interrelated areas.
blocks.visual_method: Матрица TPC с взаимосвязями.

blocks.title: Political mission and strategy
blocks.coverage: Who influences direction; stakeholder interests, coalitions and resource allocation; claimed common benefit versus unequal consequences.
blocks.visual_method: Карта интересов и ресурсов.

blocks.title: Political structure
blocks.coverage: Decision-making authority, vertical and horizontal power; restructuring shifts power as well as reporting lines.
blocks.visual_method: До/после: у кого право принять решение.

blocks.title: Political HR
blocks.coverage: Succession, rewards, bonuses and appraisal; power and fairness in who gets promoted, rewarded or evaluated.
blocks.visual_method: Путь решения о продвижении и вознаграждении.

blocks.title: Political skill and recommendations
blocks.coverage: Positive/negative politics; whose voices are excluded; networking; use Lean Production case to justify two practical recommendations, consulting provided solution only after own attempt.
blocks.visual_method: Актор → интерес → ресурс влияния → действие.

blocks.title: Understanding culture
blocks.coverage: Values, beliefs and norms; strong versus weak cultures; performance depends on what culture encourages; why direct culture change is difficult.
blocks.visual_method: Видимое поведение и лежащие под ним предположения.

blocks.title: Culture within TPC
blocks.coverage: Strategy and values, leadership style and subcultures, recruitment, training, modelling and rewards; behavioural/system routes to culture change.
blocks.visual_method: Желаемая культура ↔ реальные решения и поощрения.

blocks.title: McKinsey 7-S
blocks.coverage: Strategy, structure, systems, shared values, skills, staff and style; hard/soft alignment; diagnostic usefulness and time demands.
blocks.visual_method: Семь связанных элементов с примерами несогласованности.

blocks.title: Cultural Web
blocks.coverage: Paradigm; stories, symbols, routines/rituals, control systems, power structures and organisational structures; interdependence and limits.
blocks.visual_method: Культурная паутина на фактах организации.

blocks.title: From diagnosis to change
blocks.coverage: Anthropologists worksheet; Rio Tinto culture case; map barriers and propose practical actions without treating stated values as observed practice; use HBR reading as support.
blocks.visual_method: Заявленные ценности рядом с фактическими практиками.

blocks.title: Technical TPC and alignment
blocks.coverage: Mission/strategy, structure, HR; technology, systems, procedures and relationships; contradictions and ripple effects across subsystems.
blocks.visual_method: Одно изменение запускает цепочку последствий.

blocks.title: Vision, purpose and leadership
blocks.coverage: Vision versus goals and strategy; core values/purpose; benefits and limits of vision; leaders as facilitators rather than sole owners of vision.
blocks.visual_method: Purpose → vision → strategy → decisions; разрыв с возможностями.

blocks.title: Scenario planning
blocks.coverage: Drivers and assumptions, framework, mini-scenarios, shortlist, drafting, implications; possible futures and preparedness rather than guaranteed prediction; implementation limits.
blocks.visual_method: Дерево возможных будущих и ответов организации.

blocks.title: Galbraith Star Model
blocks.coverage: Strategy, structure, processes/lateral capability, rewards and people; align elements, compare with 7-S and recognise cultural/political omissions.
blocks.visual_method: Звезда организации с отмеченными несогласованностями.

blocks.title: Technical case application
blocks.coverage: ING Agile: changed subsystems, mutuality, overlooked issues; justify linked recommendations and consider political/cultural spillovers.
blocks.visual_method: Карта ING до/после с обоснованными связями.

blocks.title: Diagnosis and Force Field
blocks.coverage: Diagnostic versus implementation purpose; TPC, 7-S, Star and Lewin Force Field; driving/restraining forces; limits of abstract diagnostics.
blocks.visual_method: Силы за/против конкретного изменения.

blocks.title: Checklist models
blocks.coverage: DICE, ADKAR and Stouten; appropriate contexts, limitations and combination; Stouten ten evidence-based activities, local adaptation and sustaining change.
blocks.visual_method: Сравнение задач моделей, а не выбор любимой модели.

blocks.title: Stage models
blocks.coverage: Lewin three-stage, Kotter eight-stage and McKinsey 5A; time dimension, past history, maintenance and limits of tidy sequences.
blocks.visual_method: Временные линии моделей и реального процесса.

blocks.title: Contingency and Kaleidoscope
blocks.coverage: Pivotal roles, leadership styles, Stace-Dunphy; Kaleidoscope eight contextual factors and six design choices; capability versus capacity; application and criticism.
blocks.visual_method: Контекст → обоснованный выбор способа изменения.

blocks.title: Process perspective and judgement
blocks.coverage: Context, substance, transition, politics and their interaction over time; eight lessons; strengths and risks; critique of simple causality and universal recipes.
blocks.visual_method: Процесс в прошлом, настоящем и будущем, с разными участниками.

blocks.title: Model comparison in a case
blocks.coverage: British Airways through Lewin, a checklist and contingency lens; compare explanations, omissions and recommended action; do not reduce topic to ADKAR.
blocks.visual_method: Несколько моделей на одной истории с проверкой того, что каждая упускает.

blocks.title: Dialogue and overload
blocks.coverage: Monologic/dialogic communication; information versus understanding/commitment; overload, silence and staff participation.
blocks.visual_method: Одностороннее объявление рядом с диалогом.

blocks.title: Four change conversations
blocks.coverage: Initiative, understanding, performance and closure; links between language, action and the intended change.
blocks.visual_method: Карта разговоров и переходов между ними.

blocks.title: Stories and interpretations
blocks.coverage: Storytelling as sensemaking and sensegiving; employee and management versions; nostalgia as continuity/support or barrier; plausibility and identity.
blocks.visual_method: Две истории одной организации и их последствия.

blocks.title: Legitimating strategies
blocks.coverage: Normalization, authorization, rationalization, moralization and narrativization; recognise how proposed change is justified and assess evidence.
blocks.visual_method: Разные способы объяснить и оправдать одно решение.

blocks.title: Metaphors and communication choices
blocks.coverage: Marshak machine, developmental, transitional and transformational images; strategy continuum: spray/pray, tell/sell, underscore/explore, identify/reply, withhold/uphold; benefits and costs.
blocks.visual_method: Сообщение и выбранный способ общения в контексте.

blocks.title: Communication case application
blocks.coverage: Engineering Ltd Good Old Days: coexisting stories, meaning, identity and cultural resistance; propose an appropriate dialogue/communication response.
blocks.visual_method: Официальная и ностальгическая истории без выбора одной как единственно верной.
